description: React component for the Categories page in a storefront admin UI, including category tree rendering, filtering, and data fetching from API.

classes.name: CategoryTreeNodeView
classes.description: React component for rendering a category node in the category tree with expandable children.

methods.name: getCategoryDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a display string for a category based on its description, code, or ID.

methods.name: normalizeRoots
methods.description: Normalizes category roots, handling the case of a single root with children.

methods.name: filterTree
methods.description: Filters a tree of categories based on a query string.
